name: Unit converter
description: Converts lengths, masses, volumes and temperatures exactly, instead of guessing.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert a number between units. Lengths: mm cm m km in ft yd mi. Masses: mg g kg oz lb. Volumes: ml l cup qt gal. Temperatures: c f k.

from.description: Unit to convert from, for example km

to.description: Unit to convert to, for example mi
